rec.name: Product Sales Count Message Below Add-to-Cart

what.text: A short social-proof message placed directly under the Add to Cart button on the product page. A fire emoji sits next to a bold sales count ("More than 5180 times") followed by the text "sold this month! This product is currently very popular." The ticket title ("Currently in XX carts") suggests a related live cart-count variant. The ticket only links a third-party reference module (sectionheroes.de) and gives no spec.

why.text: Showing that many other shoppers have bought or are carting the product creates bandwagon social proof and reduces purchase uncertainty right at the moment of decision. The fire emoji and the phrase "very popular" add a mild urgency/FOMO signal. A high number signals that the product is validated by others.

how.text: Add a theme block directly below the buy button in the product form. Output a line of text containing an icon/emoji, a bold number and a supporting sentence. The number can be a static or merchant-defined value in the theme editor, a metafield, or a value computed from order data (e.g. units sold in the last 30 days) via an app or script. The title's "currently in XX carts" variant would need live cart-count data from an app or a custom backend, or a plausible range configured in the block. If the number is simulated, add a minimum threshold so that low values are never shown.

items: Message text with a {{count}} placeholder (editable, translatable)
Count source: manual number, metafield, or app-provided
Minimum count threshold to display the message
Time window label (e.g. per month / currently in carts)
Show or hide by product or collection

dependencies.text: Needs a data source for the number: a product metafield, an order-data app or custom script for sales counts, or an app for live cart counts. The reference module is a third-party product from sectionheroes.de. The block sits in the PDP buy box under the ATC button.

images.caption: Purple Add to Cart button with the fire-emoji message below it: "More than 5180 times sold this month! This product is currently very popular."
